claims.text: Phrasal compositionality is scored by computing the likelihood of surrounding context words given a phrase representation, indicating a context-dependent approach.
The context-driven model for compositionality detection assesses whether a phrase is predictive of its context words, thus determining its compositionality.
Compositionality scoring models can improve machine translation outputs by leveraging learned representations that account for context.
